questions.question: In head-to-head List A meetings, who has the edge, Knights or Titans?
At which ground did Suné Luus record their career-best innings (85*, T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Bloemfontein Oval, against Knights on 2017/11/19.

questions.question: At which ground did Iinyathi record their 'Largest Win by Runs' (T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Khaya Majola Oval — largest win by runs of 129, against Kei on 2019/10/27.

questions.question: Who holds the record for 'Most Catches (Fielding)' (T20)?
questions.explanation: Nondumiso Shangase holds it, with a total of 29.

questions.question: Who took South Africa Women's first-ever ODI five-wicket haul, with remarkable figures of 5 for 7 against Pakistan in February 2008?
questions.explanation: Smith took 5 for 7 in 8 overs against Pakistan at Stellenbosch on 24 February 2008, South Africa's first ODI five-wicket haul.

questions.question: Who has achieved the fifty and 3 wickets in a match double more times, Adele van Eck or Maryka Kirchoff?
questions.explanation: Adele van Eck: 1 times. Maryka Kirchoff: 2 times.
